text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican parliament on Thursday completed its second reading of a government bill on land tenure, with a large number of amendments proposed by the main opposition party, Renamo, to be voted on later in the sitting.

- Feasibility studies for a proposed new hydro-electric dam at Mepanda N'cua on the Zambezi river in central Mozambique will begin in October. The dam, downstream from the existing Cahora Bassa dam, is expected to produce between 2,000 and 2,500 megawatts of power.
